what.text: Wipro operates as an integrated and trusted enterprise transformation partner, offering consulting, technology services, engineering, and business process services. The company empowers global clients to lead in their industries through AI-powered solutions, industry-specific platforms, and tailored operating models.

segments.name: IT Services
segments.text: Provides IT services and solutions, generating revenue of $10,512 million for the year ended March 31, 2026.

snapshot.text: Wipro trades at a P/E of 14.6 with a dividend yield of 5.65 percent and a book value of 79.7 rupees.
Return on capital employed stands at 17.8 percent and return on equity is 15.5 percent.

trajectory.text: Annual revenue reached 92,624 crore rupees in FY26, showing slower 3-year CAGR of 0.8 percent compared to 5-year CAGR of 8.4 percent.
Operating margins drifted lower from 24 percent in FY21 to 19 percent in FY26, despite a slight improvement year-on-year by Sep 2026.
Quarterly revenue growth year-on-year picked up to 9.1 percent by Sep 2026, while quarterly net profit contracted 1.9 percent over the same period.

balance_sheet.text: Borrowings rose steadily from 17,593 crore rupees in FY22 to 22,106 crore rupees by September 2026.
Debt-to-equity ratio remained stable at 0.2 to 0.3 times across the reported periods.
Fixed assets expanded to 55,591 crore rupees by September 2026 alongside an increase in capital work in progress.

cash_quality.text: Cumulative cash from operations over FY22 to FY26 reached 120 percent of cumulative net profit.
Free cash flow stood at 13,447 crore rupees in FY26, down from 16,973 crore rupees in FY24.
Interest cover declined from 33.7 in FY21 to 14.9 by FY26.

numbers.answer: Borrowings rose to 22,106 crore rupees by September 2026 from 16,465 crore rupees in FY24. Meanwhile, free cash flow was 13,447 crore rupees in FY26 compared to 16,973 crore rupees in FY24.

verdict.headline: Wipro is experiencing a disconnect between accelerating year-on-year revenue growth and contracting quarterly net profits.

narrative_vs_numbers.text: Management's guidance for stable operating margins has been met, with margins holding between 19% and 20% in recent quarters. However, the company's financial performance shows a divergence where revenue growth has accelerated to 9.1% year-on-year while net profit has simultaneously contracted by 1.9%.

bull.text: The company maintains a strong cash generation profile, with cumulative cash from operations over the last five years reaching 120% of cumulative net profit.
Quarterly revenue growth has shown a positive trend, accelerating to 9.1% year-on-year by September 2026.
Operating margins have remained stable within the narrow band targeted by management, showing a slight year-on-year improvement as of September 2026.

bear.text: Net profit has contracted by 1.9% year-on-year as of September 2026, despite the reported increase in quarterly revenue.
Borrowings have risen to 22,106 crore rupees as of September 2026, while free cash flow has declined from 16,973 crore rupees in FY24 to 13,447 crore rupees in FY26.
The company's interest cover ratio has significantly declined from 33.7 in FY21 to 14.9 by FY26, reflecting increased financial pressure.
